data.title: Islamic Affairs Ministry Introduces Digital Applications to Kuwait Book Fair Visitors, Welcomes Student Groups
data.content:
Riyadh, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The booth of the Ministry of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance—part of Saudi Arabia's pavilion at the 49th Kuwait International Book Fair—welcomed school student groups on Thursday to explore publications from the King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex and learn about the Kingdom's efforts in printing and caring for the Holy Quran.
    The booth introduces visitors to the ministry's digital applications, notably the "Rushd" (Guidance), "Correct Citation," and "Virtual Hajj" apps, demonstrating how modern technology is leveraged to deliver religious services and raise awareness of Hajj rituals, alongside displays of Quranic editions and historical manuscripts.
    As part of its participation, the ministry is distributing 2,000 copies of the Holy Quran in various editions as a gift from the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, along with 350 awareness publications promoting moderation and balance. Running from November 18 to 28, the fair features 592 entities from 34 countries.
    -- SPA
